verdict.rationale: a-Shell is an iOS terminal app, not an agent itself, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no mention of an MCP server. Its Apple Shortcuts integration is an adjacent automation feature, not an MCP endpoint, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
